manifest.name: dsh-desktop-notifier
manifest.description: OS desktop toast when a session finishes a turn.

bundle.text:
- insert:
    - id: desktop-turn-notifier
      name: 'dsh-desktop-notifier'
      config:
        enabled: true
        cooldownMs: 2000

readme.text:
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows a native desktop notification when a
session completes a turn. There is no web UI; it runs on the Host, listens
for `agent/turn-stopping`, and launches the operating system's normal toast
path.

- Windows tray balloon (`NotifyIcon.BalloonTip`) using PowerShell, with an
  encoded command so titles and paths with quotes are harmless.
- macOS `display notification`.
- Linux `notify-send`.
- One bundled plugin row, enabled by default.
- Per-session cooldown of 2000 ms to avoid burst spam.
- Full session titles, resolved through the Host `sessionTitle` service.

- Windows works out of the box via PowerShell.
- macOS and Linux need the notifier executable installed (`osascript` is
  built in, `notify-send` usually via `libnotify-bin`).
- The plugin may spuriously fail to surface notifications if notifications
  are disabled at the OS layer, Focus Assist is active, or the process is not
  allowed to emit toasts. Those limits are outside the plugin's control.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:temidayoxyz/dsh-desktop-notifier
```

There is no build step; `pnpm` does not need to compile `lib/`. If you
prefer the local copy, install it with the bundle target:

```sh

The bundle inserts one plugin row with the following config:

```yaml
config:
  enabled: true
  cooldownMs: 2000
```

Edit the profile bundle or the plugin patch to change these values.

The plugin does not register tools, commands, slots, or settings rows. It only
fires when a Host agent publishes `agent/turn-stopping`. It explicitly does not
interrupt a turn if the notification spawn fails; errors are swallowed to the
console.

```sh
cd D:/Codebase/dsh-plugins/dsh-desktop-notifier
node --check index.js
```

There are no dependencies; no test harness is bundled.
